node.statement: Choose e also below the universal e_close in lem-extcb1-close-corner-dimension. That exact external gives dim S_{P,Q}=dim S_{v(I_r),Q}=r*d. The EXT-CB datum assumes S_{P,Q}!=0, so its dimension is nonzero; since r>=1, d cannot be zero. Hence d=1 and dim S_{P,Q}=r, proving node 1.3.
